visualReview.scope: Current render integrity only; maximum exterior fidelity and geographic fit remain pending.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all 15 portable frames. Four folded tapering glass walls, recessed corners, projecting clear crown walls and diagonal lattice, observatory floor, rod-supported entrance canopy and attached doors render. Corrected a framing member extending below zero and an observatory camera inside the core before final captures. Facade dimensions and entrance details remain reconstructions.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 15 world-viewer frames, including the flat-terrain geographic fixture, and verified their hashes. Five canonical metal/concrete/wood/stone graphs each load once; glazing uses local PBR. No embedded images. Viewer unload leaves zero live model geometries. The map-outline fixture demonstrates rendering and ground contact at an assumed flat datum, not approval of actual site fit.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q1542408 match to OSM way 1179710949 supplies the anchor and an undirected footprint axis. Native -Z canopy side is provisional. The owner floor plan north arrow does not independently verify the entrance direction. Preview registration is not geographic approval: signed yaw, footprint fit and actual terrain contact remain unapproved.

fidelityReview.notes: Architect exterior/crown/observatory/entrance photos and owner floor plans. Intermediate dimensions, bay counts, floor datums, structural members and entrance extent are inferred, not a measured survey. Geographic fit and maximum exterior fidelity are pending. Cached map axis is undirected and the entrance side is not approved. Upper-floor drawings are marked illustrative. Envelope taper, corner depth, canopy dimensions, floor divisions and crown levels are working reconstructions. Do not equate the marketed 300 m observatory height with the owner drawing floor-60 datum. Floor 61/62 heights in this model are provisional. The surrounding mall and neighboring towers are separate structures. Plaza boundaries, planting, connecting walkways and actual terrain remain unauthored. Glazing uses local PBR color and alpha; steel, stone, concrete and wood use canonical shared graphs. No copied photographic textures or downloaded meshes.

geometryValidation.validatorLimitations: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing is unsupported by the validator and reported as information. Independent transform/count/bounds checks and Molen renders cover instancing; other information concerns unused fallback attributes.

runtimeLodReview.scope: Visual integrity and local byte/layout checks; physical-device measurements pending.
runtimeLodReview.notes: Inspected the master and all four runtime levels side by side. An original 40 KB authored skyline preserves the tapered outline and four open crown walls. District, street and closeup are 2.33, 3.29 and 7.33 MB; the detailed master is 14.96 MB. Detailed triangle targets remain advisory and district/street exceed them to preserve large surfaces. Initial skyline and district downloads each fit the 3 MB phone target; device frame time is not measured.
